listing.name: Gudalanmu 0.27
listing.aiSummary: Adds an alien faction with high-tech ships that use missiles, fighters, and energy weapons.

description: Introduces a wandering alien faction that arrives in the north-eastern core worlds. Their fleet features exotic high-tech vessels equipped with a mix of energy weapons, missiles, and fighters. Recent updates include a new system for the Ambush-class frigate that slows time for targeted ships.
